Metapod?! |pokemonname=Dodrio |current=[[Party|With Yellow]] |va=no }} '''Dody''' (Japanese: '''ドドすけ''' ''Dodosuke''), known as '''Dodosk''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translation of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}, is a {{p|Dodrio}} that {{adv|Yellow}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]]. Yellow was given Dody as a gift from her uncle, [[Wilton]], making him her second {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. As of ''[[PS290|A Well-Journeyed Jumpluff]]'', he is at [[level]] 33, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "quick tempered." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}=== Prior to the start of the chapter, Dody was given to {{adv|Yellow}} as a Doduo by her uncle, [[Wilton]]. Dody first appeared as a Doduo in ''[[PS042|Do Do that Doduo]]'', riding Yellow around in her search for {{adv|Red}}'s {{p|Pikachu}}, [[Pika]]. He is later sent out to battle against {{adv|Professor Oak}}'s {{p|Spearow}} in order to test Yellow's skills. Doduo uses {{m|Whirlwind}} to stop Spearow's {{m|Fury Attack}} from landing. Oak responds with {{m|Mirror Move}} and the two birds arrive at a stalemate. At this Doduo dashes around Spearow, and amidst the spinning of the Whirlwind, Spearow loses its balance, plummeting towards the ground to be caught safely by Pika. Yellow then explains to Professor Oak that she won the battle without anyone getting hurt. Oak notices that Yellow battled with a high level of control and accepted she might be able to save Red. In ''[[PS044|Do Wrong, Dewgong!]]'', [[Lorelei]] attempts to steal Pika from Yellow. Dody uses {{m|Drill Peck}} to break her ice slide, allowing the group to run away and hide. After figuring out how to escape, Dody was used as the group's escape, using his incredible speed to help them run away. [[File:Yellow battling Lance.png|thumb|200px|left|Dody battling Lance]] In ''[[PS048|Paras Sight]]'', Dody battled alongside [[Ratty]] against {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} in an attempt to rescue Pika. Completely pinned by Miles's attack, Yellow decides to give herself up to {{p|Marowak}}'s {{m|Bonemerang}}, recalling Dody and Ratty before taking a direct hit to the chest. Although injured, Yellow attaches Dody and Ratty's {{i|Poké Ball}}s to the bone, which comes swinging back at him. Dody and Ratty then get released and help Pika to escape. When Miles pursues them, the three release a combo attack, with Ratty breaking apart a nearby building with his teeth, Dody kicking them in the air, and Pika electrifying them and sending it at Miles, defeating him. In ''[[PS057|Ekans the Ecstasy]]'', Dody battled the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]] members, Ken, Al, and Harry. Using Whirlwind, he blows all of Yellow's Pokémon away, allowing them to position themselves for the job they needed to do to save the sinking [[S.S. Anne]]. In ''[[PS082|Eradicate Raticate!]]'', Dody is sent out alongside his teammates to battle against [[Lance]] and his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Dody attacks with a powerful {{m|Peck}}, but {{p|Dragonite}} simply shrugs it off and throws Dody away. He is [[PS087|later]] used in a team attack to try and stop Lance from shooting bubbles. Yellow had [[Kitty]] cover the volcano crater in silk with {{m|String Shot}} to form a net that is doused by a {{m|Water Gun}} from [[Omny]], linked to Ratty's sensitive whiskers. Upon Lance triggering the net, Ratty signals to Pika to send electricity down the net, forcing Lance's bubble into view. Yellow then orders Dody to break the bubble with Drill Peck, but the attack proves too weak. [[File:Yellow and Dody.png|thumb|250px|right|Dody and Yellow]] In the final battle against [[Lance]] in ''[[PS089|The Might of... Metapod?!]]'', after Yellow had lost the [[Pokédex]], Dody [[Evolution|evolves]] into a Dodrio to gain more power. He then assisted in defeating Lance's team. ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== In ''[[PS140|Do-Si-Do with Dodrio]]'', Dody used his quick speed to save [[Chuchu]] from a fall. In ''[[PS173|The Last Battle VII]]'', Dody helped Pika and Chuchu escape the {{pkmn|Day Care}} when the half-masked [[Team Rocket]] Grunts attacked. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== Dody was last seen in ''[[PS292|Bested by Banette]]'', where he was intended to help battle against [[Sird]] and [[Orm]]. Before getting the chance to fight though, the two capture {{adv|Silver}} and leave. In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Dody and Yellow found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Yellow checked on Dody and the rest of her team to ensure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}. ==Personality and characteristics== Dody has a strong relationship with his {{pkmn|Trainer}} and is one of two Pokémon she kept before starting her journey. He is a powerful and fast Pokémon who is often used as land transportation for {{adv|Yellow}}.
